evidence.note: Trains a 1.5B reasoning model to emit one of three mode tokens (NoThink, Short, Long) as the very first token of its response and to reason under that mode's budget, learned end-to-end inside GRPO with no separate router.
evidence.title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test-Time Compute Allocation

evidence.note: A test-time-compute-allocation framework unifies where to spend compute (which unresolved queries get more sampling) with how generation is performed there (conditioning new samples on in-context demonstrations retrieved, via semantic similarity, from other queries already solved during the same inference run) -- consistently beating uniform Best-of-N and a difficulty-adaptive elimination baseline in coverage-per-token across four model families and multiple math/coding/reasoning benchmarks, with gains concentrated early in test-time scaling.
evidence.title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation with Evolving In-Context Demonstrations
